problem:
What is the range of the function $f(x)=-\frac{9}{2x+9}+5\,?$

The range is
$f(x)\in (${{field-1}}$,$
{{field-2}}$)\cup (${{field-3}}$,\infty ).$
worked_solution:
A transformed reciprocal function of the form

$$
f(x)=\frac{a}{bx+c}+d
$$

has the horizontal asymptote $y=d,$ and therefore, its range is

$$
f(x)\in (-\infty ,d)\cup (d,\infty ).
$$

In our case, $d=5.$ Therefore, the horizontal asymptote is $y=5,$ and the range of the function is

$$
f(x)\in (-\infty ,5)\cup (5,\infty ).
$$
